tutorial.reserve: The reserve on the left holds 20 cards. Only the top one is playable, but **an empty column refills from it automatically**, so spending the reserve is what keeps the board moving.
tutorial.foundation: There are eight foundations, two per suit. They all start at the rank the deal turned up, build up in suit **wrapping King round to Ace**, and take 13 cards each -- 8 x 13 = 104.
tutorial.tableau: Eight tableau columns. Build down **in suit** by one, wrapping Ace round to King. Runs move as a unit.
tutorial.emptyColumn: The empty column is the heart of the game. **While the reserve holds cards a gap refills from it automatically; once the reserve is gone, only the waste can fill a gap.** A tableau card can never move into an empty column.
tutorial.stock: Turn the stock one card at a time onto the waste. **There is exactly one redeal**, so think before you start the second pass.
tutorial.controls: Draw, hint, undo, auto-complete, and the other controls.

hintReason.toFoundation: Sending this card to a foundation frees up the board
hintReason.toTableau: Take the suggested tableau move to dig out the card underneath
hintReason.fromReserve: Empty columns stay tied to the reserve until it is gone
hintReason.draw: Nothing can move, so turn a card from the stock
hintReason.redeal: You are out of moves. The redeal is a one-shot, so check for anything missed before spending it
